regex: 档案|资料|工作阶段|设定|预设值|基因体|胺基酸|软体|程式|萤幕|介面|执行绪|快取|载入|储存|匯|栏位
message: Taiwan wording in the mainland catalog: use 文件, 数据, 会话, 设置, 默认, 基因组, 氨基酸, 软件, 程序, 屏幕, 界面, 线程, 缓存, 加载, 保存, 导入/导出, 字段 (STYLE 3.1).
Biology terms are 细胞器 (not 胞器) and 链 for strand (not 股) (STYLE 3.1).
Accession is 登录号; 登入号 means "log-in number" (STYLE 4.4.1).
Avoid 您 unless the sentence needs a pronoun (STYLE 3.2); leave the subject out.
请 may open an instruction at most once per message (STYLE 3.2).
No space between Chinese and digits: 10条记录, 最小一致性（%）; only an interpolated identifier takes spaces (STYLE 3.3).
No space follows 。 between two sentences (D-18).
The mainland catalog quotes with “ ” and nested ‘ ’ (STYLE 3.3).
